profile.name: Shaohu Zhang
profile.intro: I study how intelligent systems can better assist and protect people: their privacy, their security, and their everyday lives.
profile.institution: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University
bio: My research focuses on trustworthy AI, mobile computing, and cybersecurity. I use AI and machine learning with ubiquitous modalities—including WiFi signals, cameras, and acoustics—to develop applications that protect sensitive personal data and secure AI systems.
I collaborate across transportation engineering, sociology, health, agriculture, and data science. I lead the X+ Intelligence Lab and am affiliated with the Cyber Defense and AI Lab.

I earned my Ph.D. in Computer Science from North Carolina State University in 2023, working with Prof. Muhammad Shahzad in the Wolfpack Interactive, Sensing, and Networking Lab and with Prof. Anupam Das in the Wolfpack Security and Privacy Research Lab. From 2023 to 2025, I was an assistant professor in Computer Science at UNC Pembroke.

lab.tagline: Trustworthy intelligence for a connected world.
description: X+ Intelligence Lab studies trustworthy AI, mobile computing, and cybersecurity. We explore WiFi signals, cameras, acoustics, and other ubiquitous sensing modalities to protect sensitive personal data and strengthen AI systems.

Our work connects security and privacy, context-aware and explainable AI, mobile sensing, and large language models. Applications span transportation, smart homes, and agriculture, with collaborations across sociology, health, and data science.

research.title: Security and privacy
research.description: Fingerprinting and human biometric security, with a focus on privacy and authentication through embedded sensors in digital devices.

research.title: Trustworthy and explainable AI
research.description: Context-aware mobile systems that connect cyber-physical systems and AI for reliable, adaptive interactions.

research.title: Mobile computing
research.description: Sensing with WiFi, cameras, inertial measurement units, virtual reality, unmanned aerial vehicles, and sound for intelligent transportation and smart homes.

research.title: Large language models and NLP
research.description: Speech privacy, speech translation, and applications of large language models in agriculture and transportation.
